771160101.text: ...There is a part of my body right here. I can sense it more and more strongly now.

771160102.text: It's... in the direction of that building over there. No, to be more precise, it's behind that building.

771160103.text: Yes, over there... Do you see it? That's "home" for everyone in town.

771160104.text: You mean that huge house over there? That's where everyone lives together?

771160105.text: That huge house is our assembly hall. That's where everyone's hearts, everyone's leaves, and everyone's love are, all in one place. That's why it's home for everyone.

771160106.text: And a house is just a house. You don't get it, do you, Paimonka? "A house is merely a place to live, while a home is where the heart truly resides."

771160107.text: My, my, how clever of you, Nastya-ka. So tell us, what does "reside" mean?

771160108.text: Um... well... "reside"... it's like "decide," you know? So home is the place where you can listen to your heart and choose whatever you want?

771160109.text: That doesn't sound quite right... but it does kind of make sense too...

771160110.text: Heh heh, but of course! Doctor Moreau also said that out of all the children here, I'm the smartest and most like him...

771160111.text: It's all the fault of those horrid Volkodlak! If they hadn't taken me away... I should have my beautiful leaves by now. I should be able to understand the land and the trees by now...

771160112.text: Can you imagine how cool it is to understand what they're saying? And once you're family, you can grow branches too... You two aren't Badbugs. I believe you can do it!

771160113.text: Hmm... imagine tree branches growing out of Paimon's head... That actually sounds kinda cool, doesn't it...?

771160114.text: Then we'll get an even more special Paimon!

771160115.text: Special...? But it's not good to be special...

771160116.text: Doctor Moreau said we'll stop fighting and competing once we're all the same. When that happens, everyone will get along perfectly.

771160117.text: But it's impossible for everyone to turn into exactly the same thing.

771160118.text: #{M#He's}{F#She's} right, you know! Even if you all turn into trees... some would be tall, some would be short, some would have green leaves while others are more yellow...

771160119.text: ...You do sound a little more right than the Doctor... And it's true. Sometimes I'd look at my leaves and my friends' leaves to see whose are prettier...

771160120.text: ...But once I get all my leaves, I won't have to eat anymore. Then, I can play Catch the Bug with my friends in the woods all day long!

771160121.text: W-W-W-What!? What do you mean, you don't eat!? No way! A-Anyway, branches growing out of Paimon's head would look really weird on someone who flies, okay!? Let's just forget about it!

771160122.text: Paimon would rather have a belly full of food than be special any day...

771160123.text: You seem to have gotten the wrong idea, Paimonka? What I meant was that we won't be afraid of going hungry. But if you really want something yummy, that's totally fine too.

771160124.text: And there are so many other cool things about growing branches! Like... your body won't even hurt if you fall down super hard, because you'll be way bigger and stronger!

771160125.text: I know maybe you don't believe me right now. But once you see my family, you'll know what I mean.

771160126.text: Hmm... it does sound pretty cool to grow branches and stuff... But anyway! Let's get to town first! Then we'll find out if what Nastya's saying is true!

771160301.text: Yeah, that's right... This is where all our new friends used to get off... All we gotta do now is keep walking that way...

771160302.text: I know the way now. We gotta to walk through the station first.

771160303.text: Not many people know how to get around here because the Doctor said nobody's allowed to come to the station... But I do!

771160304.text: I was here once before when I was playing Catch the Bug... The Doctor was bringing some new friends to town right then, and when he saw me, he gave me a ride back too.

771160305.text: That's weird. Why would he forbid everyone from coming here...? There doesn't seem to be anything special about this place...

771160306.text: Oh, the Doctor said that's to keep everyone safe. Because we never know if any of our new friends are actually Badbugs.

771160308.text: ...Or does he mean that not all newcomers are good people, and some of them could possibly be Badbugs?

771160309.text: Um... I only know the Doctor said that it takes only one Badbug to ruin a whole forest. That's why we have to get rid of all of them!

771160310.text: So, once Doctor Birdie catches all the Badbugs, we can all have a warm home full of love together...

771160311.text: I always win whenever I play Catch the Bug. Doctor Moreau even says that at this rate, I'll become a real Doctor Birdie soon, and catch all the Badbugs!

771160313.text: And it sounds a little dangerous, too. Why would the Doctor ask a kid to do something like this...?

771160314.text: Oh? You don't have to worry about me! Zala will help me too. Not only does she protect all of us, she can tell right away if somebody is a Badbug! She's so cool.

771160315.text: Actually, Zala is the real Doctor Birdie... No, no, no, with those huge wings of hers, Zala is the Big Doctor Bird!

771160316.text: Huh... "Bird"... Paimon's heard something about that before... Something about a strange giant bird in this town...

771160317.text: I don't know who you heard that from, Paimonka... But they must be talking about Zala!

771160318.text: We'll see her once we're in town. And if she's in a good mood, you might even get to touch her beautiful leaf-feathers!

771160319.text: ...You do have to be careful, though, because Zala can get grumpy very easily. She's only good when the Doctor is around.

771160320.text: Especially you, Paimonka, you have to be extra careful. You're so small and light like a leaf, Zala might just blow you far, far away if she flaps her wings!

771160321.text: #Don't you worry about that! {NICKNAME} will hold on to Paimon!

771160322.text: Hmm... now that we're talking about it, Paimon really wants to see this Zala bird for herself now!

771160323.text: Then let's get going! I don't really know where she is in town right now... But we'll definitely find her if we go looking for her!

771160324.text: Huh... Looks like there isn't a way through here either. We'll have to pass through the station then...

subQuests.subQuestName: Pass through the station with Nastya

771160502.text: One... one... more... time... Become... new...

771160503.text: (Looks like communicating with her is off the table...)

771160201.text: This is where we usually play Catch the Bug. But nobody seems to be around today... So I'll just play with you instead.

771160202.text: But... since the two of you helped me, you're definitely not the Badbug.

771160203.text: I'll be the Badbug then. You two can play as Doctor Birdie. It's two against one, I'm going really easy on you!

771160204.text: The rules are simple: catch me, and you win.

771160205.text: Do we have to play right now?

771160206.text: Yes. The Doctor said it's super important that we follow every single step of the ritual.

771160207.text: You don't have to go easy on me, because I'm going to win either way.

771160208.text: Okay.. But since Paimon can fly, she'll be a really good Doctor Birdie, that's for sure!

771160209.text: But what if we can't find you?

771160210.text: Then we'll meet at the <color=#00E1FFFF>town entrance</color>... Are you two ready? Let's begin!!!

771160211.text: This Doctor Birdie is in position.

771160212.text: And this Doctor Birdie is in position too!

771160213.text: Okay. Now relax, close your eyes, and count down from 60... Once you get to zero, you can start looking for the Badbug!

771160214.text: 60, 59, 58... You count down silently in your head, as you get ready to "Catch the Bug."

771160215.text: #{NICKNAME}! {NICKNAME}! Open your eyes! She's almost gone!!!

771160216.text: I can't believe you'd cheat like that!

771160217.text: You gotta play fair, you know!

771160218.text: What? No, no, this isn't the time to argue about something like this! Paimon was just in the middle of her, uh... "tactical glimpse" where she realized that...

771160219.text: She can go wherever she wants, but everywhere we go, we'll just keep running into dead ends! Come on, if we don't follow her now, we might get stuck here!

771160220.text: And, and — it's not like we know the way to the town entrance!

771160221.text: So we'd better catch up with her now while we still can!

771160902.text: Huh? Wow, you're a really good Doctor Birdie! You caught me before I even got to hide...

771160903.text: No, no, we've been running after you! This game of "Catch the Bug" is on pause for now!

771160904.text: Too bad we didn't finish it this time.

771160905.text: #But we'll do it next time for sure! That's because you can go everywhere, Nastya, but {NICKNAME} and Paimon can't.

771160906.text: I've found a serious loophole in the game rules...

771160907.text: #{NICKNAME} is right... You can go everywhere, Nastya, but the two of us can't!

771160908.text: So if we had waited for you to hide before coming to look for you, we might've ended up getting lost in the woods!

771160909.text: Heh heh, it’s all thanks to Paimon's incredible deductive and strategic skills that we're all here together now!

771160912.text: ...Alright, we'll play again next time then! When I get home, I'll get everyone together for a game of Catch the Bug! It's gonna be so much more fun!

771160913.text: The grown-ups over there just told me where I can find everyone!

771160914.text: Oh, so you were talking to them? They... can speak!?

771160915.text: What are you talking about? They are family! Of course I can talk to them...

771160917.text: Don't worry, Aunt LePuy. They aren't Badbugs. They are good people who brought me home... Yeah, I'll make sure they grow beautiful leaves too!

771160918.text: (Seriously? All these giant Leshy are Nastya's "family"??? Well... she does have branches growing right out of her head... But aside from the tree stuff... she looks just like any other kid!)

771160919.text: (Wait, what if her entire family turns out to be Leshy!? Does that mean we're gonna have to follow her all the way inside?! And why is Paimon getting nervous just thinking about it!?!!!!!!)

771160920.text: (We still need to go in there to look for Goggles' body part...)

771160921.text: (Since we promised to take her home anyway...)

771160922.text: #...{M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, Paimonka, are you still taking me home? The grown-ups are awfully busy, as always...

771160923.text: Paimon doesn't think it's a good idea to let her go home all by herself...

771160924.text: And besides — we haven't even seen that "Zala" Nastya keeps talking about yet! Wouldn't it be a real pity if we walked away now?

771160925.text: Let's do it. Just to make sure that Nastya gets home safe and sound...

771160926.text: Let's do it. Just to make sure that we see Zala with our own eyes...

771160927.text: We'll come with you and take you back to your family. The two of us always get the job done!

771160928.text: Thank you so much... You two really are awesome! Almost as awesome as my idol Furiosa...

771160930.text: Alright, Aunt LePuy. I won't bother you anymore. I'm off then!

771160931.text: #The grown-ups are too busy for me... {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, Paimonka, let's keep going.

771160932.text: Alright, let's keep going then! But hold on, what are they doing?

771160933.text: Oh? They're burning the Badbugs! The Badbugs among the new friends, and the old friends who have turned into Badbugs too... They all have to be burned up!

771160934.text: "Once reduced to ash, the Badbugs will nourish the soil, while it is from that same earth that new family will grow." That's how the bad can become good all over again!
